blurb: Guests are flown by helicopter to remote locations between Whistler and Pemberton for mountain biking on technical trails or to stay in a private alpine yurt. The yurt sleeps six and includes a living room, kitchen, and patio with mountain views. The experiences offer access to wild places few get to see.
